description: Integration gate for the composed LMARS gnomonic cubed-sphere shallow-water RHS (problems/duo_swe.esm, model DuoSWFreestream, test freestream_rest_preservation) at fixed resolution N=8 (C8). Runs the full three-prognostic system -- D(dp)/dt = flux_divergence_duo_g3 (LMARS continuity), D(ua)/dt & D(va)/dt = momentum_{u,v}_duo_g3 (Coriolis + upwinded vorticity + kinetic energy) + pgrad_l97_{u,v}_duo_g3 (L97 four-corner pressure gradient) -- through each binding's official simulation pathway from a rest initial state. The composed RHS is exactly zero at rest, so this proves the whole duo spatial core (geometry chain, 3-layer donor-cube halo duo_extend, volume-mean reconstruction, LMARS solve, metric raise-then-reconstruct) lowers and integrates as one field system without match conflict, and preserves the free stream. The per-rule discretizations are pinned separately by the duo ast conformance cases; this manifest routes the runners (assertions + tolerances live in the problem). Python is REQUIRED as of EarthSciAST caea886aa (whole-box broadcast contraction in the numpy interpreter): full gate 6/6 PASS in 2688 s measured 2026-08-29 under CPU contention. Rust is REQUIRED as of EarthSciAST 34f064149 (the strict `native` compiler, now the default, covers the reduced-rank/contracted makearray region values the duo momentum rules lower to): Erk 1e-10/1e-12, full gate PASS in 12 s measured 2026-10-19.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
